_comment: One basket page per week, each published fresh by /courses and recorded here. /courses push reads the week's link from this file to find the push request, so `weeks` must always name the page she is actually using; everything under `duplicates` is a superseded page for the same week and must never be read for a push. The week of 2026-09-14 has three pages: a531ad93… was published first and never used; AsuNh1… is the one she approved and pushed from on 15 September; 96VqXg42… republished the same week on 16 September to give her the Kitchen tab and the editable week, carrying her favourites, the week document and the finished push across; version 2 of that page, the same day, rebuilt it on the 15 September receipt once that invoice was added, which is why the kitchen asks about her corrections from the 5 September one. The page before 2026-09-14 served every week from one bookmarked URL; it is kept as oldSharedPage and no longer updated.
